compare.note: baseline = git ref snapshot; current = working tree snapshot. If the worktree is mid-cleanup (P1 in progress) numbers may be partial; re-run after the cleanup lands.

definitions.glue: src/**/*.rs outside layers, src/bin and bench_head/bench_pre
definitions.jaccard: stripped non-empty line sets, lines < 4 chars ignored

duplication.note: cross-layer non-test line-set Jaccard; grows when code is copied, not directly a violation unless the pair count increases

p1_projection.assumptions: bench_head+bench_pre moved out of src/ and all *.bak deleted; nothing else changes

d3_historical_reference.note: 参考值；本工具在 git-ref 快照上重测 archive，.bak 不可重测
